category_edits.rationale: Replace batch-global negative weighting with mean smooth ranking loss. Each prediction has one sampled negative, so softplus(logsumexp(negative − positive)) reduces to softplus(negative − positive). Exclude padding and accidental positive matches. This may improve HR@10 by training all valid transitions consistently while preserving the model and training configuration.

change_summary: Change only the learning objective to mean sampled-negative smooth ranking loss across all four category models; architecture, sampling, inference, and training schedule remain unchanged.
